name: Power Band
pmdDesc: A hold item that slightly boosts the Pokémon's Attack.

name: Special Band
pmdDesc: A hold item that slightly boosts the Pokémon's Special Attack.

name: Defense Scarf
pmdDesc: A hold item that slightly boosts the Pokémon's Defense.

name: Zinc Band
pmdDesc: A hold item that slightly boosts the Pokémon's Special Defense.

name: Choice Band
pmdDesc: A curious headband that boosts Attack, but only allows the use of one move. This item sticks when held.
desc: Attack ×1.5, but every move recharges 25% slower.
descKo: 공격이 1.5배가 되지만 모든 기술의 재사용 시간이 25% 늘어난다.

name: Choice Specs
pmdDesc: Distinctive glasses that boost Special Attack, but only allows the use of one move. This item sticks when held.
desc: Sp. Atk ×1.5, but every move recharges 25% slower.
descKo: 특수공격이 1.5배가 되지만 모든 기술의 재사용 시간이 25% 늘어난다.

name: Choice Scarf
pmdDesc: A curious scarf that boosts Movement Speed, but only allows the use of one move. This item sticks when held.
desc: Move 30% faster, but every move recharges 25% slower.
descKo: 이동 속도가 30% 빨라지지만 모든 기술의 재사용 시간이 25% 늘어난다.

name: Assault Vest
pmdDesc: An offensive vest that raises Special Defense, but prevents the use of status moves. This item sticks when held.

name: Scope Lens
pmdDesc: A lens used for scoping out weak points. It boosts the holder’s critical-hit ratio.
desc: Critical hits happen far more often (1 in 8).

name: Life Orb
pmdDesc: A held item that boosts the power of moves, but at the cost of some HP on each use. This item sticks when held.
desc: Moves deal 30% more damage, but each attack costs 3% of max HP.
descKo: 기술의 위력이 30% 오르지만 공격할 때마다 최대 HP의 3%를 잃는다.

name: Expert Belt
pmdDesc: A well-worn belt that boosts the power of super-effective moves.

name: Shell Bell
pmdDesc: A held item that restores a little HP to the holder every time it inflicts damage on others.
desc: Restores HP equal to 1/8 of the damage you deal.

name: Big Root
pmdDesc: A held item that increases HP recovery.
desc: Slowly restores HP while standing still.
descKo: 가만히 서 있으면 HP가 조금씩 회복된다.

name: Metronome
pmdDesc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts moves used consecutively, but only until a different move is used.
desc: Each attack in a row without getting hit deals 10% more damage (up to +50%).
descKo: 맞지 않고 연속으로 공격할 때마다 데미지가 10%씩 오른다 (최대 +50%).

name: Wide Lens
pmdDesc: A magnifying lens that boosts the Pokémon's Accuracy.
desc: Your projectiles and area attacks have 40% bigger hitboxes.

name: Iron Ball
pmdDesc: A held item that weighs the Pokémon down, forcing it to pause between moves. It also allows Ground-type moves to hit Flying-type and levitating holders. This item sticks when held.
desc: Move 25% slower, but take 15% less damage.
descKo: 이동 속도가 25% 느려지지만 받는 데미지가 15% 줄어든다.

name: Twist Band
pmdDesc: A held item that prevents the Pokémon's Attack and Special Attack from being reduced.
desc: You are never knocked back or flinched by hits.

name: Warp Scarf
pmdDesc: A held item that warps the Pokémon to another place on the floor after being attacked.
desc: Your dodge becomes a long-range teleport.

name: Sitrus Berry
pmdDesc: A large berry with a well-rounded flavor. It gradually restores HP for a few turns.
desc: Once per fight, restores 25% HP when you drop below half.
descKo: 한 번의 배틀에 한 번, HP가 절반 아래로 떨어지면 HP를 25% 회복한다.

name: Reviver Seed
pmdDesc: A seed that revives a fainted Pokémon, then becomes a Plain Seed after use.
desc: Once per fight, revives you with 30% HP instead of fainting.
descKo: 한 번의 배틀에 한 번, 쓰러지는 대신 HP 30%로 부활한다.

name: Charcoal
pmdDesc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a combustible fuel that boosts the power of Fire-type moves.

name: Mystic Water
pmdDesc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This teardrop-shaped gem boosts the power of Water-type moves.

name: Miracle Seed
pmdDesc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a seed imbued with life force that boosts the power of Grass-type moves.

name: Magnet
pmdDesc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a powerful magnet that boosts the power of Electric-type moves.

name: Never-Melt Ice
pmdDesc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a piece of ice that repels heat effects and boosts Ice-type moves.

name: Black Belt
pmdDesc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This belt helps the wearer to focus and boosts the power of Fighting-type moves.

name: Poison Barb
pmdDesc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This small, poisonous barb boosts the power of Poison-type moves.

name: Soft Sand
pmdDesc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a loose, silky sand that boosts the power of Ground-type moves.

name: Sharp Beak
pmdDesc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a long, sharp beak that boosts the power of Flying-type moves.

name: Twisted Spoon
pmdDesc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This spoon is imbued with telekinetic power and boosts Psychic-type moves.

name: Silver Powder
pmdDesc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a shiny, silver powder that will boost the power of Bug-type moves.

name: Hard Stone
pmdDesc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a durable stone that boosts the power of Rock-type moves.

name: Spell Tag
pmdDesc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a sinister, eerie tag that boosts the power of Ghost-type moves.

name: Dragon Scale
pmdDesc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This thick, tough scale boosts the power of Dragon-type moves.

name: Black Glasses
pmdDesc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A pair of shady-looking glasses that boost the power of Dark-type moves.

name: Metal Coat
pmdDesc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a special metallic film that can boost the power of Steel-type moves.

name: Silk Scarf
pmdDesc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a sumptuous scarf that boosts the power of Normal-type moves.

name: Pink Bow
pmdDesc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a cute bow that boosts the power of Fairy-type moves.
